title: PM Triage Report
description: The triage report PM writes in /dev-overnight TRIAGE mode (agents/pm.md, Step 9), docs/dev/overnight/<session_id>/triage-report-cycle<N>.json; G2 checks it at PM's own stop. The orchestrator creates the cycle's pipelines from it through scripts/build-pipelines-from-triage.py, which joins pipeline_order to issues[].triage_index and carries each issue's description, location, severity and tier into its pipeline. task_id is the identity the obligation names. Every other field of the PM payload is allowed.
